analysis.language: English (with visible offer wording in English and Danish in CTAs)
analysis.primaryGoal: Drive orders/select target product ranges to unlock a free mystery box
analysis.audience: B2B customers interested in jewelry packaging/new product lines
analysis.offer: Free Mystery Box upon qualifying purchase (DIY kits: £400, £800, £1200)
analysis.primaryCta: READ ALL ABOUT THE MYSTERY BOX OFFER ➔

visualStyle.imageStyle: studio product photography with soft shadows, consistent white background

copyStyle.urgency: moderate (limited time, 'new arrivals', 'make room for the autumn')

reusablePatterns: Lead with a bold, value-focused headline paired with a strong visual of the offer
Divide features by product lines for clarity and easy comparison
Insert product photos between text for visual breaks
Use explanatory subheads for each product/series
Stack CTA buttons after each major product block and at the end
Wavy horizontal section dividers in campaign color
List pricing tiers vertically with connecting graphics
Reinforce offer in both headline and the email footer
risks: Offer complexity (tiered spend requirements could be misunderstood)
Multiple CTAs potentially distract from main objective
Heavy product focus could feel sales-heavy to some recipients

confidence.notes: All major campaign, offer, product, and design details visible. Some small print in footer is blurred but overall structure, CTAs, and visual style are clear.
